sources.title: Exact disproofs of two attack-graph targets (reverse Lemma 4 repair; last fall vs BFS d_reg)
sources.citation: research/disprove_easy_targets_20261102/PROTOCOL.md (frozen before computing), reverse_census.rs, salizzoni_ex39.py, results/, and the Lean modules papers/ic-negative-results/lean/IcNegative/Lemma4Reverse.lean and research/disprove_easy_targets_20261102/lean/SalizzoniEx39.lean.

nodes.label: Reverse repair d'_F <= d_F (outside), unrestricted
nodes.statement: For every system over F_2, with the field equations outside the generating set, the fake first fall degree is at most the true first fall degree (equality reading).
nodes.scope: Proposed in this corpus as a repair of Nagao's refuted Lemma 4 (GAP-LEMMA4-REVERSE). Refuted by systems whose reduced generators are linearly dependent; the form with linearly independent reduced generators survives (GAP-LEMMA4-REVERSE, MEAS-LEMMA4-REVERSE-CENSUS).
non_implications: Says nothing about systems with linearly independent reduced generators
Does not affect the refutation of Nagao's Lemma 4 itself (d_F <= d'_F)

nodes.label: Witness R {X, X^2+X}: d_F = 2, no fake fall
nodes.statement: Over F_2, f_1 = X, f_2 = X^2 + X: with the field equations outside, X*f_1 + f_2 = X is a fall at degree 2 and none exists below, so d_F = 2; f_2 reduces to 0 modulo the field equations, leaving one effective generator, so no fake fall exists at any degree (d'_F = infinity).
nodes.scope: Exact. Hand proof in the Lean docstring; native census instrument; core-Lean decide +kernel module, kernel-checked by the repository proof gate. Degenerate by construction: one generator is a field equation.

formal.notes: Encoding bridges as in Lemma4Witness (mask completeness; reduction a ring homomorphism), argued not formalised. fake_noFall covers every degree by a degree bound in the quotient. lean-proof-gate run 41396053760 (commit d722ba45e): papers/ic-negative-results/lean PASS, 32 theorems, 0 trusted (8 from Lemma4Reverse).

nodes.label: Reverse-repair census: 0 nondegenerate counterexamples in 531,497 pairs
nodes.statement: Exact census of unordered pairs (dmax 6): P1 multilinear deg <= 2, n = 3: 7875 pairs, 0 reverse counterexamples outside (reproduces the prior census); P2 all deg <= 2, n = 2: 1891 pairs, 204 counterexamples; P3 all deg <= 2, n = 3: 521731 pairs, 7126 counterexamples. Every counterexample has linearly dependent reduced generators and no fake fall; none has linearly independent reduced generators.
nodes.scope: Pairs only; degree <= 2; n <= 3; F_2; equality reading. Inside placement for reference: 14336 pairs with d_F < d'_F both finite in P3.

nodes.label: 'last fall <= d_reg' with BFS d_reg
nodes.statement: For every polynomial system, the last fall degree is at most the degree of regularity d_reg in the Bardet-Faugere-Salvy sense (least d with (F^top)_d = R_d).
nodes.scope: The reading of HKYY's true statement (CLAIM-GB-LFD-LE-DREG, where 'degree of regularity' is a solving degree) with the BFS definition substituted; repeated in later introductions. Refuted by Salizzoni Ex. 3.9: last fall 3 > d_reg 2.

nodes.label: Salizzoni Ex. 3.9 (k=2) checked exactly: d_x = d_y = 3, d_reg = 2
nodes.statement: For F = {x^2 + y, y^2 + x, xy} over F_2, F_3, F_5 and Q: (F^top)_2 = R_2 and (F^top)_1 = 0, so d_reg = 2; x, y are not in V_{F,2} and are in V_{F,3}; V_{F,d} = (x, y) cap R_{<=d} for d = 3..6. Hence last fall degree 3 (Caminata-Gorla Thm 2.9 with the reduced Groebner basis {x, y}).
nodes.scope: Exact linear algebra (salizzoni_ex39.py); the F_2 memberships and the top parts are also kernel-checked in core Lean (repository proof gate). The Thm 2.9 step is cited, not formalised.

formal.notes: lean-proof-gate run 41396053760 (commit d722ba45e): SalizzoniEx39.lean PASS, 4 theorems, 0 trusted.

edges.statement: Witness R has d_F = 2 outside and no fake fall at any degree.
The unrestricted repair is refuted; the open form keeps the hypothesis that the reduced generators are linearly independent.
No counterexample with linearly independent reduced generators among 531,497 pairs (degree <= 2, n <= 3).
Last fall degree 3 > 2 = BFS d_reg for {x^2 + y, y^2 + x, xy}.
HKYY's inequality holds only with their meaning of 'degree of regularity' (a solving degree); with the BFS meaning it fails.
Confirms the inferred last-fall value by exact computation over F_2, F_3, F_5 and Q.
